name: Paychex Flex
description: Paychex Flex is Paychex's payroll and HCM platform for small to midsized businesses, covering payroll, time and attendance, benefits, and HR compliance in packaged tiers scaled by employee count, with pricing available only by contacting sales.
best_for: Small to midsized employers wanting a long-established payroll provider with tiered HCM packages that scale from a handful of employees up to larger headcounts.
features: Payroll processing with automated multi-state tax calculation, filing, and payment
Direct deposit, check processing, and an employee self-service portal
Intelligent Pay Cycle that flags payroll issues, such as missing punches or data errors, before submission
Paychex Pre-check, letting employees review their paycheck before payroll is finalized
HR compliance monitoring and document generation
Time and attendance and benefits administration connectivity
Tiered packages (e.g., Basic, Foundations, Advanced, Complete) that add analytics, hiring services, a custom handbook builder, and employee engagement tools at higher levels
Mobile app access for employers and employees to manage payroll and benefits on the go
pros: Backed by an established, decades-old payroll tax engine and compliance infrastructure
Packaged tiers scale from very small businesses (1+ employees) up through larger headcounts (30+ employees) within the same product line
Three support tiers are offered, from self-service to dedicated payroll specialists
cons: No pricing is published on paychex.com; every plan requires contacting sales or requesting a quote for a price
Higher-tier features such as premium analytics, hiring services, and employee engagement tools are gated behind the Advanced and Complete packages

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.notes: For businesses with 1+ employees. Unlimited payroll processing, HR foundations, time-off accruals, and analytics essentials. No published price; requires contacting sales.

tiers.name: Foundations
tiers.notes: For businesses with 10+ employees. Adds enhanced customer support, enhanced analytics/reports, and LMS essentials.

tiers.name: Advanced
tiers.notes: For businesses with 20+ employees. Adds premium analytics/reports, hiring services, and a custom handbook builder.

tiers.name: Complete
tiers.notes: For businesses with 30+ employees. Adds premium customer support and employee engagement tools such as recognition, collaboration, and performance reviews.

alternatives.name: ADP Workforce Now
alternatives.description: ADP's HCM suite for small to midsized businesses, combining payroll, HR, time, and talent management.
alternatives.best_for: Employers comparing established, decades-old payroll providers with similar tax-compliance depth to Paychex.

alternatives.name: Gusto
alternatives.description: A payroll, benefits, and HR platform focused on small and mid-sized U.S. businesses with published, self-serve pricing.
alternatives.best_for: Smaller employers wanting transparent published pricing instead of a sales-quote process.

alternatives.name: Paycom
alternatives.description: A single-database HCM platform covering payroll, talent, HR, and time management, including employee-driven self-service payroll entry.
alternatives.best_for: Employers wanting a single-database HCM alternative with employee self-service payroll input.
